canonicalFacts.claim: Hydroxychloroquine is recommended for all SLE patients at doses not exceeding 5 mg/kg real body weight
Treatment goals in SLE include achieving remission or low disease activity and preventing flares
Glucocorticoids should be minimized to less than 7.5 mg/day prednisone equivalent during chronic maintenance treatment
Belimumab is the first biological agent approved for treatment of systemic lupus erythematosus
SLE predominantly affects women of reproductive age and shows higher prevalence in certain ethnic groups including African American, Hispanic, and Asian populations
Lupus nephritis is a common major organ manifestation causing significantly increased morbidity and mortality
CAR-T cell therapy targeting CD19+ B cells has shown promising early results in severe autoimmune diseases including SLE

redFlags: Hydroxychloroquine can rarely cause erythroderma requiring drug withdrawal
Cardiovascular disease is a major cause of death in SLE patients
Bacterial infections remain an important cause of mortality in SLE

pipelineDrugs.name: CAR-T cell therapy
pipelineDrugs.mechanism: Targets CD19+ B cells to eliminate autoreactive B cell populations
